Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner changed criteria mid-task—switching from using the earliest widely recognized theatrical release to the “primary-country official” date for Niyoti (24 June 2016), while using Angali Pangali’s 17 June 2016 date. This ignored Niyoti’s earlier India release on 10 June 2016, which would make Niyoti the earlier film. The inconsistent criteria and treating a “scheduled” official date as definitive led to the wrong conclusion.
